name: @orbitmines/physics-repository
description: Everything here is defined in implementation/*.ray and generated from it: `npx ray gen`, `npx ray test`, `npx ray visuals`. See implementation/README.md.

scripts.test: ray test && cd tests/ts && node --import tsx --test G.test.ts && cd ../.. && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/py -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test:gpu: deno test --unstable-webgpu --allow-all tests/ts/G.webgpu.test.ts && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/py -p 'test_G_*.py'
